title: Felix and the Harbor
author: D. M. Quintana
blurb: Freya Okonkwo, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
